topArticle.title: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus
topArticle.description:
Switzerland says patient is wife of Swiss diplomat and believed to have contracted virus while travelling in Uganda
Health officials across Africa are racing to determine how Nigeria’s first Ebola patient ⁠in more than a decade ⁠became infected, amid fears ​the outbreak could spread further after reaching a fourth African country.
The Swiss foreign ministry said on Friday the patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of ⁠Congo, where the outbreak was first detected in mid-May before spreading to Uganda, Kenya and now Nigeria. The woman was believed to have contracted Ebola while travelling with her husband in Uganda, the ministry added.
 Continue reading...

topArticle.title: Lewis Hamilton aims to extend career till early 2030s so he can race in African Grand Prix
topArticle.description:
41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’

Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights record

Lewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s. The seven-time world champion believes it is right that F1 is to hold a race there despite criticism of the country’s human rights record.
Last week F1 confirmed Rwanda was to host the African Grand Prix having concluded a 10-year agreement for the meeting on a purpose-built circuit, with the first race set for the early 2030s. It is lined up to be held on a circuit in Bugesera, 25 miles south of the capital, Kigali, which has yet to be constructed and marks a return to the African continent for the first time since it last held a race at Kyalami, South Africa in 1993.
 Continue reading...

Hepatitis B study in Guinea-Bissau that was to be funded by CDC and that drew global backlash ‘will not move forward’
The US-backed hepatitis B vaccine trial in African newborns that drew global backlash was halted, the lead researcher said on Wednesday.
It was “now clear” that the study “will not move forward in Guinea-Bissau”, Frederik Schaltz-Buchholzer, a Danish researcher, wrote on LinkedIn, adding, “we were not given the necessary governmental approval.”

Police closed case of Andrew Frederick despite autopsy report ruling his death a homicide
A time-critical investigation into the death of a British father whose body was found in a ransacked property on the Caribbean island of Grenada has stalled because of diplomatic delays between the two countries.
Charity workers supporting the family of Andrew Frederick are demanding immediate government intervention to clear the path for a full investigation to begin almost 10 months after his death, which has been ruled a homicide by a pathologist.

The Royal Bahamas police force said it had launched an investigation after the death of a 36-year-old woman on Tuesday.

topArticle.title: Rubio tells Cubans ‘now is the time’ to act to see political change
topArticle.description:
US secretary of state makes comments after Trump tells US rally warships could intervene on return from Iran
Marco Rubio urged Cubans seeking political change in their country to act, saying “now is the time” moments after Donald Trump told a Friday rally for candidates in south Florida that US warships could intervene in Cuba on their way back from the Iran war.
The US secretary of state, in his social media post addressed “to those who seek to create positive change”, urged Cubans to capitalize on Trump’s plans. “The disappointment of failed promises, corruption, and the privileged lives of only a few; seize this opportunity to create the change you desire through a discrete [sic] partnership with the CIA,” Rubio said.
 Continue reading...

topArticle.title: Ex-prosecutor charged with treason in Mexico over US drug raid
topArticle.description: César Jáuregui Moreno is accused of allowing US agents to join a raid on a suspected drugs lab in April.
topArticle.titleJa: メキシコ、元検察官を米国による麻薬摘発への協力で国家反逆罪に問う
topArticle.summary: メキシコで、元検察官セサル・ハウルギ・モレノ氏が国家反逆罪で起訴された。彼は4月に疑わしい麻薬研究所への米国の捜査官の参加を許可したとされている。

topArticle.title: Venezuela faces a deepening energy crisis as protests grow
topArticle.description: Venezuela’s worsening electricity crisis is disrupting daily life, pushing frustrated residents into the streets as prolonged blackouts expose the fragility of the country’s power grid.
topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラ、エネルギー危機が深刻化し抗議活動が拡大
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラで電力危機が悪化し、長期にわたる停電が人々の日常生活を混乱させている。不満を抱いた住民が街頭で抗議活動を行う中、同国の電力網の脆弱性が露呈。

topArticle.title: Peru’s Indigenous people in Cutivireni and Oviri take the front line against Amazon wildfires
topArticle.description: As El Niño worsens dry conditions, Peru’s indigenous people in Cutivireni and Oviri are taking action to protect their Amazon territory from wildfires.
topArticle.titleJa: ペルーの先住民がアマゾン森林火災に対し最前線で立ち向かう
topArticle.summary: エルニーニョ現象が乾燥を悪化させる中、ペルーのクティビレニとオビリに住む先住民が、アマゾン領土を森林火災から守るため自ら行動を開始。

topArticle.title: How Ecuador is fighting to keep industrial trans fats off the food shelf
topArticle.description: As health advocates push for tighter controls, Ecuador confronts the gap between regulating trans fats and enforcing those rules.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルがいかにして工業用トランス脂肪酸を食品棚から排除しようと戦っているか
topArticle.summary: 健康擁護者がより厳格な規制を求める中、エクアドルはトランス脂肪酸の規制と実施との間のギャップに直面している。食品棚から工業用トランス脂肪酸を排除するための課題を探る。

topArticle.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan
topArticle.description: One person has died after being swept away by waves in Taiwan's Liuqiu island, authorities say.
topArticle.titleJa: 台風チャンピーが台湾を閉鎖し、数百便が欠航
topArticle.summary: 台風チャンピーが台湾を直撃し、数百便が欠航。離島では波に流され1名が死亡したと当局が発表した。

topArticle.title: Celebrity shark guided out of South Korea canal refuses to swim out to sea
topArticle.description: Bukangi the shark became an unlikely sensation after it was spotted in a canal in Busan weeks ago.
topArticle.titleJa: 韓国の運河から誘導された人気サメ、「ブカンギ」が海に戻ることを拒否
topArticle.summary: 釜山の運河で発見され、たちまち人気者となったサメ「ブカンギ」が、海への誘導を拒否している。

topArticle.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
topArticle.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.
topArticle.titleJa: 日本は世界クラスのイベントで知られるが、アジア競技大会は混沌としていた
topArticle.summary: ホテルや交通機関の混乱、外交上の失策など、アジア競技大会の組織委員会と運営会社に注目が集まった。

topArticle.title: Why is a peat fire so bad? BBC is in Indonesia to find out
topArticle.description: The BBC's Liza Tambunan is in central Kalimantan, to explain what peat is and why Indonesia is facing its worst wildfire season in a decade.
topArticle.titleJa: 泥炭火災はなぜこれほど悪いのか？BBCがインドネシアで取材
topArticle.summary: BBCのリザ・タンブナンは、インドネシアが過去10年で最悪の山火事シーズンに直面する中、泥炭とは何か、そして火災がなぜ深刻なのかを中央カリマンタンで調査する。

topArticle.title: The Philippines launches safeguard investigation on pork
topArticle.description: On 21 October 2026, the Philippines notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of pork.
topArticle.titleJa: フィリピンが豚肉に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 2026年10月21日、フィリピンはWTOに豚肉輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことを通知した。

topArticle.title: Talks kick off for Timor-Leste's accession to government procurement pact
topArticle.description: At a meeting of the Committee on Government Procurement on 14 October, parties to the Government Procurement Agreement (GPA) 2012 welcomed Timor-Leste's submission of key documents required to kick off its negotiations on acceding to the Agreement. The Committee also reviewed regulatory developments, heard updates on the accession process of other members, and for the first time conducted a dialogue with the private sector on the significance of the Agreement in a changing trade environment.
topArticle.titleJa: 東ティモール、政府調達協定加盟に向けた協議を開始
topArticle.summary: 10月14日、政府調達委員会で東ティモールの政府調達協定加盟交渉開始に向けた重要書類提出が歓迎された。

topArticle.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
topArticle.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
topArticle.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の菓子類に対するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 2026年10月12日、マダガスカルはWTOに対し、砂糖菓子やチョコレート菓子の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したと通知した。

topArticle.title: WTO-ITC visit to Mogadishu supports Somalia's preparations for next phase of WTO accession
topArticle.description: The WTO and the International Trade Centre (ITC) conducted their first joint technical assistance activity in Mogadishu, Somalia, from 10 to 15 October to support the government's preparations for the second meeting of the Working Party on the accession of Somalia. Supported by the United Kingdom, the technical assistance event also included discussions on regional integration and the forthcoming Trade for Peace Somalia Initiative.
topArticle.titleJa: WTO-ITC、ソマリアのWTO加盟次段階準備を支援するためモガディシュを訪問
topArticle.summary: WTOと国際貿易センター（ITC）は、ソマリアのWTO加盟作業部会第2回会合準備を支援するため、モガディシュで技術支援活動を実施した。
